title: matra Document, schema 2.x
description: One analysed document as matra emits it: the `result` of `matra analyze --json`, what Python's `Document.to_dict()` returns, and the serde form of `matra::domain::Document`. Schema 2.x: `provenance.schema` is "2.minor". A minor adds optional fields only, so a reader ignores fields it does not recognize and rejects a major it does not know. Every string set a reader receives is open (`format`, `kind`, `pos`, `dep`, `mood`, `pattern`, feature names): treat an unknown value as data, not as an error. Every key listed here is always present, except the two a provenance carries only on a derived result (`method`, `parameters`), and the three `matra analyze --json --depth` removes below the level it is asked for: `sections` at `document`, each paragraph's `sentences` at `paragraph`, each sentence's `tokens` at `sentence`. Every library call, and Python, returns all three, and Rust's `Document` reads a cut document back with the removed keys as empty. A value that does not apply is null rather than absent. Every `span` counts UTF-8 bytes of the analysed text: for markdown and plain text the input itself, for block input the blocks' texts joined by a blank line. The text fields are normalized; a span is the authority on where a value came from.

sections.description: Always present, except under `matra analyze --depth document`.

skipped.description: What the reader saw and did not analyse, in document order. Never silently dropped.

Span.description: A stretch of the analysed text in UTF-8 bytes, `byte_start` inclusive and `byte_end` exclusive. Bytes, not characters: a language that indexes strings by character converts before slicing.

Skipped.description: A construct the reader saw and did not analyse, with where it lies.

kind.description: The construct: `table`, `code`, `front_matter`, `html`, `thematic_break` or `link_definition` today. An open set.

ratio.description: A measure, or null when its condition was not met.

Provenance.description: Where a result came from and what produced it. A document carries it without `method` and `parameters`, the two keys of this schema that are not always present; a result derived from a document (a summary, keyphrases, clusters) carries the document's provenance with both added. No timestamp: matra's outputs are deterministic.

matra.description: The matra version that produced the result.

schema.description: The schema version, "major.minor". The one place a schema version appears.

format.description: The format the input was read as: `markdown`, `plain_text` or `blocks` from the readers matra ships, `pdf` or `docx` from a reader a caller registered, or the name of another format a caller's reader reads. An open set.

method.description: The method that produced a derived result: `tfidf`, `textrank`, `rake`, `yake` or `cosine` today. An open set. Absent on a document.

Parameters.description: The parameters that shaped a derived result, as it ran. Only those the method takes are present: `n` for a summary and keyphrases, `threshold` and `embedder` for clusters. Absent on a document.

n.description: How many sentences a summary keeps, or how many phrases keyphrase extraction returns at most.

threshold.description: The cosine similarity an edge between two sentences cleared to join them in a cluster.

embedder.description: The embedder whose vectors were clustered, as it reports itself: the same shape as `provenance.parser`, so the embedding model's name, digest and licence travel with the scores.

Identity.description: A model-backed component: its name, and the model it ran with that model's digest and licence where known. A model matra does not pin has a null `model` and `license`.

ProvenanceSource.description: The analysed input: its path, and the length and digest of the analysed text every span points into.

path.description: The path the input was read from, null for in-memory text. Bytes of a path that are not UTF-8 arrive as U+FFFD.

DocumentMetrics.description: The document's aggregates. The counts are always present; each ratio is null when its condition was not met.

span.description: The heading in the analysed text, markers included; null with no heading.

kind.description: The block the paragraph was read from: `paragraph`, `quote` (never parsed or measured) or `list_item` today. An open set.

sentences.description: Always present, except under `matra analyze --depth document` or `paragraph`.

ParagraphMetrics.description: The paragraph's measures; each is null when its condition was not met.

tokens.description: Always present, except under `matra analyze --depth` above `token`.

tree_depth.description: Longest path from a token to the root; null when the parse's head references loop.

features.description: CoNLL-U column 6 as a map from feature name to value; a multi-valued feature keeps its value unsplit ("Nom,Acc").

ClausalComplement.description: A verb governing a clausal complement (`ccomp`), with its subject when the parse has one.

RootMood.description: The root clause's `Mood` feature (an open set: `Ind`, `Imp`, ...) and the root's token id.

pattern.description: The construction that matched: `such_as`, `such_np_as`, `including`, `especially`, `and_other`, `or_other` today. An open set.
